build_sam_vit_b_encoder: build a SAM ViT-B image encoder with a checkpoint loaded for feature extraction
create_ImageEncoderViT: create a Vision Transformer image encoder with configurable depth, embed_dim, and attention heads
create_MLPBlock: create a two-layer MLP block with configurable embedding dimension and activation function
create_LayerNorm2d: create a 2D layer normalization module that normalizes across spatial dimensions per channel
create_Attention: create a multi-head attention block with optional relative positional embeddings
